title: The Rise and the Reading
gist_ar: نص أكاديمي مكثّف: الارتفاع في التشخيص مش نفس الارتفاع في الحالة.
text:
The rise in recorded diagnoses is not in dispute. The interpretation of that
rise is, and the distinction turns almost entirely on the reliability of
detection rather than on any change in prevalence.

Three processes coincided after 2014. The introduction of routine screening in
secondary schools produced a step change in ascertainment. The implementation of
a broader diagnostic threshold widened the category itself. And the expansion of
regional clinics reduced the geographical scarcity of assessment, with the
predictable consequence that areas previously showing low rates showed rates
close to the national mean within two years.

The significance of this ordering is easily missed. Because the three overlapped,
the accumulation of cases looks like a single emergent trend. Differentiation
between them requires the raw distribution, which is available, and the
correlation with clinic openings, which is strong enough that its omission from
the 2019 summary is difficult to explain.

None of this supports the more comfortable conclusion, namely that nothing has
changed. Even after adjustment for ascertainment, a residual increase of roughly
four per cent per decade persists, and its verification is the one genuinely open
question. The utilisation of services has risen far faster, which is a separate
matter, and the deterioration in waiting times follows from that rather than from
any change in the underlying condition.

The tendency in public discussion is to treat the whole rise as either artefact
or emergency. The compilation of evidence supports neither. It supports a modest
real increase, a large measurement effect, and an intervention problem in
capacity that the diagnostic argument has been extremely useful in obscuring.

questions.q_ar: الكاتب بيقول الارتفاع بيعكس إيه بشكل أساسي؟
options: A pure measurement artefact with no real change
A large measurement effect plus a modest real increase

questions.q: Why did low-rate areas move towards the national mean?
questions.q_ar: ليه المناطق منخفضة المعدل اقتربت من المتوسط القومي؟

questions.q: What does the writer find hard to explain about the 2019 summary?
questions.q_ar: إيه اللي الكاتب شايفه صعب تفسيره في ملخص 2019؟
options: It used the wrong diagnostic threshold
It omitted the correlation with clinic openings

questions.q: What does the writer say the diagnostic argument has obscured?
options: The real increase of four per cent per decade
